extracted.summary: A solicitor enquires on behalf of a wife in divorce proceedings about a £144,000 litigation loan against roughly £702,000 of assets in dispute.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry on behalf of your client. We have noted the £144,000 funding requirement and the approximately £702,000 of assets in dispute. To take this further we would need confirmation of the jurisdiction and court dealing with the matter, the current stage and any listed hearing dates, a breakdown of the costs to be funded, and details of the assets offered as security along with any existing charges. Once we have those we can send our criteria and application form and consider the enquiry further.
